author: Sevoo
body:
Hey Im Sevo Im kewl. Most of you have probably seen me destroy nubs in game, so you know how good I am =P. I have extrememly good ping, and Im not proud of it, but that doesent make me a good player. My strafing tactics are amazing. I can circle, stimpy strafe, zizag strafe (cross between stimpy and jitter strafing) jitter strafe, half circle and quarter circle, and occasionally the good ol straitline =P. I have 26k kills, 22k deaths, so I kill more than I die. I get 60 fps, since I built a PC, so you guys dont need to worry about me lagging. Anyways, Im a good player, and Im looking for a spot in the top teams. Im good at everything except defending.  My skype: SevoMC

I have no TS.
